description: Rust-native Minecraft world storage: content-addressed section dedup + zstd container. v0.9.55 WORST CASE: the -90% claim does not rest on untouched chunks - ALL 262144 chunks stored through the normal pipeline. v0.9.57 THE GATE CAUGHT THE CORPUS: 3 chunks whose 'edit' was canonically invisible (quantized round-reseed heights in flat zones) were caught by the CI gate and the edit was made constructive (corner block broken in every round>0 chunk). v0.9.58 THE STREAMING EXPORT: the CI runner was not flaky - the export was. export_dir materialized EVERY chunk payload (~5 GB at 262k chunks) into RAM before writing a region byte; the fix groups KEYS only and streams one region at a time. v0.9.59 THE CONTAINER IS THE WORLD: Anvil stops being a stored artifact - serve_region renders any region in memory byte-for-byte identical to the export view, serve_chunk is the engine-hook entry (one region entry for a mod shim), the takeover import DRAINS the .mca it reads. CI serve gate: 65536-chunk world taken over, played live (every chunk edited), 0 .mca files on disk, 64/64 regions byte-identical, served bytes re-import + verify ok=65536 bad=0. 77/77 tests green.
